scope: Offline Node CPU harness; real public WASM engine and production CitySidewalks/SidewalkBuild. No browser/GPU/frame timing.

settings.workerCadenceBasis: simulation.worker.ts WORLD_PUBLISH_MS=500; at 30 render frames/s, one publish opportunity each 15 frames; structural snapshots are revision/signature gated

schedulerAssumptions: Each render frame advances engine ticks using a 20 Hz worker accumulator multiplied by speed 8, then calls CitySidewalks.update exactly once.
Worker snapshots are checked every 500 ms of simulated wall time; snapshot publication occurs only when sidewalk-relevant road/node signature changes.
Replacement counts are pending jobs superseded by a changed sidewalk signature at a structural snapshot; commits are newly attached root child identities.
